Name: George Gets a Bed
Author: AirynS
Description:
A simple mod, this edits George & Evelyn's bedroom to expand it a little so there's space for a double bed and edits their schedules so that they sleep in it instead of poor George having to sleep in his wheelchair and Evelyn having to stand all night.

Update: Since 1.6 changed George & Evelyn's bedroom to have a double bed in vanilla, the mod now tweaks their bedroom a little so that they can actually use the double bed CA gave them! The schedule edits are the same as before.

To install, simply extract the "[CP] George Gets a Bed" folder and drop it in your Mods folder.

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b]:
[/size][list]
[*]Recolours: Should be compatible with all recolours as it only uses vanilla assets.
[*]SVE[b]: This mod is not compatible with SVE.[/b] SVE includes its own map edits so it is impossible for them to be compatible and I will not add schedule compatibility. Comments asking for SVE compatibility will be deleted.
[*]Social George (no longer available): Will adapt to Social George's schedule changes.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url]﻿: Compatible with DSV's schedule changes for Jewish Evelyn and George.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12442]Less Ugly Town Interiors[/url]: ﻿If you prefer George Gets a Bed's more lightweight map edits, then set "Alex's House" to "false" in LUTI's configuration options. If you prefer LUTI's map edits but would still like to use this mod's schedule edits, set "Alex's House" to "true" in LUTI's configuration options and set "LUTICompatibility" to "true" in George Gets a Bed's configuration options.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22955]Immersive Characters - Shane[/url]﻿: Compatible with Immersive Shane's schedule edit for Evelyn (so that Shane has a doctor visit instead).
[/list]
